knowledge: Confirmed female; tall, dark hair, old burn scar on right cheek; travels as Pellwick Imports; stays at Rusty Dragon or White Deer when in Sandpoint; three days overdue on current visit

Confirmed the seventh cycle requires seven collected bodies to open a door wider for an entity called only 'Her.' The Third kept the ledger of the count, now lost. A Choir member who spoke Her true name — 'Mother of Closed Eyes' — was quietly removed afterward. Someone will replace the Third; the cycle doesn't stop for one dead collector.
Confirmed by Chask Haladan to be the operative known as the Collector, who runs collections beneath the Fish Alley warehouse for the Spire trafficking network.
Appears to be a vessel or manifestation of something older. Driven by debt, not spite. The amulet is a binding mark. It will follow the mark, not the body.
Walked into the Whisperwood with the third goblin wave six hours before the party arrived. Something in the forest is frightening her own goblin sentries.

Identified the party as Daeris's agents. Recognized the half-fey bloodline from shadow magic. Retained full tactical awareness despite both arms being disabled. Demonstrated some form of damage absorption tied to the marker stone.
He was in the warehouse the entire time. He knows about the girl. He knows about Morwen's bloodline obligation. He's willing to trade her life for information.
Used Hemlock as a flanking distraction. Has not intervened directly. Is waiting for something specific. The target is Morwen's amulet, which it calls a vessel.
Watched the full extraction. Pointed deliberately at Morwen's amulet before closing fist and withdrawing. Motivation unclear.

Knows Ammut by name. Knows the medallion was broken. Claims seventeen obligations transferred to the wife's amulet. Uses a skin template to carve runes. Voice runs on two registers. Not entirely human anymore.
The Collector is the woman who runs collections beneath Chask's warehouse for the Spire trafficking network, and is the same figure previously tracked as an investigator
Confirmed to be the same person who used the alias 'Marasova' with Chask, revealed to have already been observing and cataloguing the party rather than seeking information.

knowledge: Successfully opened the seam-door, led the descent into the Spire's hidden stairwell, and scored a critical sneak-attack kill on a Pale Lurker in the flooded chamber below.

Scouted the flooded chamber alone, found the chained prisoner corpse, directed combat against the Drowned Grafting, and searched the body for clues, finding a brass token, cipher vellum, and an unmarked iron ring.
Located and subdued the robed grafter alone in a back workshop; found a tray of iron rings identical to those collected off bodies since Sandpoint, being strung onto leather cords.
Directly questioned Ilvane about the cost of being 'brought in proper' and the location of her graft
Extracted confirmation from Durnah that Sable is a child and learned the consequences of Sable finding the workshop compromised.
Drew a firm personal line against killing a child; insisted on confirming Sable's nature before anyone acts against her.
Found hidden second reins behind the cart's rear axle, rigged for something walking rather than riding, and read the vellum note left atop the crate: 'You were expected. Sable's fine.'
Chose to dismiss the oilcloth's 'Third confirmed her' note as meaningless and had it discarded.
Cased the canal-lock street and identified a boy and a net-mender as likely lookouts rather than idle locals; entered Wyla's shop via the back door and made first contact with Wyla directly.
Claimed the Thassilonian runeforged blade, named it Cleaver, and made it his primary weapon.

Used fey sight to identify the pale creature in the black pool as an ancient, starved Thassilonian silkworm-kin, its feeding lines long dead, confirming the forge complex was a production facility rather than a simple armory.

Scouted Jorgenfist's ritual chamber alone and discovered a human-made satchel marked with the closed-eye cipher sitting beside an old scholar-giant working glowing Thassilonian tablets, confirming the Spire's network extends directly into Mokmurian's war camp.

events.note: Scouted the breach and giant hall alone, overheard confirmation of the forge's existence, and found a hidden service tunnel bypassing the giants
Found a stone disc carved with a spiral rune in the crowned skeleton's ribs, and bowed to the ancient king's remains before scouting the forge passage alone
Successfully infiltrated Jorgenfist's ritual chamber using a diversion and invisibility, stealing the closed-eye satchel without engaging the giants
Killed Mokmurian with a single unseen sneak attack using Cleaver while Morwen's Silence masked the strike
Freed a stone giant straggler from a rusted slaver's collar in the pines north of Sandpoint, choosing mercy over Cleaver's hunger after determining he posed no threat
Cased Lord Grieva Kesslian's Alabaster District manor and laid out a full robbery plan
Gave Frizwick her promised reckless afternoon, stealing wine and each other in a dead lord's cellar
